comparison.objective: Set and lock a mechanical opening stop versus configure a control panel from a setup sheet and start it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool seating and mechanical countertorque; the busybox requires reading settings, operating switches, dial and sliders, then simultaneous two-button pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained stop motion; the busybox requires the P2 control state and a valid two-hand start without forbidden controls.
comparison.reason: The busybox tests instruction-conditioned control operation and start interlocking, not mechanical calibration or resistance to locknut-induced drift.
